input.value: Grease fire on stove during cooking; extinguished with fire extinguisher. Charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage on ceiling and walls.
Grease flare-up while sauteing onions on stove
Kitchen only — cabinets, ceiling, walls; rest of house unaffected

input.rationale: The incident is a grease fire originating from the policyholder's own stove, causing structural damage (charred cabinets, smoke-damaged ceiling and walls) to the insured home, with no theft or third-party liability involved.

Damage is limited to kitchen cabinets, ceiling, and walls from a contained grease fire — no structural collapse, no injuries, and no estimate provided, but cabinet replacement plus smoke remediation on walls and ceiling typically falls in the $2,000–$25,000 range.

input.claim_summary: Policyholder Alex Doe (POL-1001) experienced a contained kitchen grease fire yesterday evening. A flare-up while sauteing on the stove caused charring to the cabinets above the stove and smoke damage to the kitchen ceiling and walls; the rest of the home is unaffected and no injuries were reported. Claim is classified as property_damage at medium severity; no repair estimate has been provided yet and should be obtained by the adjuster.
